args.body:
Dear Litware Team,

We’ve updated your billing contact in our system to **accounts@litware.ai**. Your invoices will now be sent to this address moving forward.

Additionally, your late fee refund of **240** has been processed and will reflect in your next statement. Let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
